category: hosted feature flags and remote configuration

free_tier.stated: Forever Free plan, USD 0 a month, no credit card required: 10 feature flags, 2 environments, 2 products, 5 million config JSON downloads a month, 20 GB network traffic a month, 7-day audit log, unlimited seats, service connections, MAUs and feature flag reads
free_tier.notes: The plan is metered by config JSON downloads and network traffic, not by seats or monthly active users. The next plan, Pro, is USD 110 a month with 100 flags, 25 million downloads and 100 GB traffic. Downloads and traffic over the plan are soft limits: ConfigCat keeps serving config and contacts the account.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-flag value size cap is stated on the pricing or subscription-limit pages read

retention.stated: 7-day audit log retention on Forever Free; 35 days on Pro and Smart; 2 years on Enterprise and Dedicated
retention.notes: This is audit-log retention; no retention period for flag values or identities is stated on the pages read.

egress.terms: not applicable: a flag service metered by config JSON downloads and network traffic; the Free plan includes 20 GB network traffic a month with soft limits, not a byte-price egress charge

interface_detail: A Public Management API at https://api.configcat.com based on HTTP REST with JSON, with an OpenAPI v3 description and a Swagger UI; it creates, reads, updates and deletes flags, configs, environments and products. The API is not used to evaluate flags: SDKs or the ConfigCat Proxy download config JSON from the CDN and evaluate flags locally.
tooling: ConfigCat SDKs for JavaScript, .NET, Java, Go, Python, Ruby, Angular, React, Node.js, PHP, Elixir, Android, iOS, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, C++, Rust, Unity and Unreal Engine, or any HTTP client against the Management API
chaining: Serve remotely controlled flags and config to an app on free compute, downloading config JSON from the CDN and evaluating locally to stay under 5 million downloads and 20 GB traffic a month.

limits.value: 5 million config JSON downloads a month on Forever Free
20 GB network traffic a month on Forever Free
10 feature flags, 2 environments and 2 products per account on Forever Free
7-day audit log retention on Forever Free

limits_note: Unlimited seats, service connections, MAUs, contexts and flag reads on every plan. ConfigCat calls downloads and traffic soft limits and continues serving config past them while contacting the account; the flag, environment and product counts are plan limits.
binding_note: The 5 million monthly downloads and 20 GB traffic bind first for a client-side app that refreshes flags on each page view; flag count is capped at 10 but does not grow with traffic.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers sign up through Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Bitbucket or Active Directory, and a Company Account through SAML SSO; the pricing page states no card is required and the FAQ names the account email address. A direct email-and-password field was not present in the captured sign-up text; whether a later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Downloads and network traffic are soft limits: ConfigCat continues serving config on a temporary spike and contacts the account on sustained overage. Uptime target is 99% on Forever Free; no SLA on the free plan. Support is best effort through Slack or email.
confidence_note: Every value is quoted from the first-party pricing page, subscription-limit page, Public Management API reference and sign-up page. No account was opened; the exact sign-up fields and any post-registration steps are unverified: behind a sign-up. No flag read was probed, so the record stays at documented rung.
